title: 第1573章 暗流22第1572章 暗流21
content_zh:
蒋恩缓缓环顾四周，目光在两条一模一样的隧道上来回扫视，眼底带着几分犹豫，轻声开口询问：“前路被分成两条，我们现在该走哪条路？”
贝克微微前倾身体，抬手指向左右两侧的通道，目光反复比对，语气满是迟疑与纠结：“到底是选这边的通道，还是那边的？两条路看起来都能通行，根本分辨不出差异。”
蒋恩再次仔细打量两条隧道的入口、岩壁走势与地面痕迹，片刻后轻轻摇头，语气平淡地说道：“肉眼看不出任何区别，两条路的路况、走势几乎一模一样，无从判断优劣。”
贝克低头沉思片刻，快速权衡利弊，很快想出了稳妥的探查方案，抬头对着众人开口提议：“既然无法分辨，那我们分头探查。大家每条隧道各往前行走五十步，一旦没有发现线索、前路不通或是异常情况，就立刻折返回来在这里汇合，再重新商议对策。”
“这个办法稳妥，就这么办。”蒋恩微微颔首，坦然应允了这个提议。
敲定方案后，贝克立刻转头看向身旁的工人贾克，快速做好分组安排：“贾克，我和你结伴同行，我们走这条宽敞开阔的主通道，探查这边的路况。”
贾克没有半分迟疑，当即点头应下，语气干脆：“行，那我们即刻出发。”话音落罢，二人并肩迈步，踏着昏暗的光线，稳步朝着前方宽敞的主隧道纵深走去，身影渐渐融入幽深的黑暗之中。
目送贝克与贾克二人的身影彻底消失在通道尽头，蒋恩转头看向身边沉默伫立的高个工人，正要开口说话，对方已然精准领会了他的未尽之意，主动轻声接话：“剩下的通路，就只有这条狭窄的小路了，我们走这边。”
蒋恩微微点头示意，二人对视一眼，无需多言，已然达成默契。随后一同抬脚，小心翼翼地踏入了另一侧狭窄幽暗的小路隧道之中，继续向前探查。
与此同时，空旷死寂的大厅之内，巨大的石像静静伫立在场地中央，冰冷的石面映着微弱的光线，透着森然的死寂。波丽小小的身子紧紧蜷缩在石像背靠的阴暗角落，整个人深埋在阴影之中，不敢发出半点声响。起初，她还能强行按捺住心底的慌乱与焦躁，屏住呼吸，神经紧绷地留意着大厅内外的所有动静，时刻警惕着突发的危险。可时间一分一秒缓缓流逝，漫长又煎熬的等待不断消磨着她的耐心与定力。
周遭始终死寂一片，未知的恐惧悄然蔓延、层层积压在心头，让她再也无法安稳蜷缩躲藏。心底的焦灼与不安彻底泛滥，她缓缓挺直蜷缩的身体，慢慢站起身来，在空旷冰冷的大厅里来回踱步、不安晃荡。她的目光慌乱地扫过四周的石像、墙壁与幽暗的出入口，眉眼间满是忐忑、惶恐与无措，整个人都被无形的紧张感包裹，每一寸呼吸都透着极致的不安。
（“作家！达……”看到作家后祭司立即就想喊，但是作家马上阻止道：“我们都站在同一边，沙摩。”
躲在昨处的作家继续说道：“你不信任张佛是出于本能，我不信任他是因为我知道真相。”
祭司看着作家怀疑的问道：“我为什么要相信你？”
“这是个很好的问题，我希望我能想出一个好的答案。”作家说。
祭司放松了下来，随后说道：“好，告诉我你知道什么？”
作家意识有卫兵已经来到他的身后，他直接说道：“在这儿谈？”
祭司说道：“我知道个不会被打扰的地方。”于是作家跟着他离开。
矿区的某处通道，四个人聚在一起。
“现在走哪条路？”蒋恩看向四周问。

“这一边，还是那一边？”贝克指着通向前面两处的通道问。
“哦两个都差不多。”蒋恩说。
“我们试着在每条隧道上走五十走，然后再回头。”看向通道的贝克提议道。
“嗯。”蒋恩也点头同意。
“贾克，我想我和你一起走，我们走这条大路。”贝克跟那个叫贾克的工人说道。
“哪，那我们走吧。”贾克点头同意的道，两人向着一条通道走去。
content_en:
Jiang En slowly looked around, his eyes darting back and forth between the two identical tunnels. With a bit of hesitation in his eyes, he asked softly: "The road ahead is divided into two, which way should we take now?"
Baker leaned forward slightly, raised his hand to point to the passages on the left and right sides, and compared his eyes repeatedly. His tone was full of hesitation and entanglement: "Should I choose the passage here or that one? Both roads seem to be passable, and I can't tell the difference at all."
Jiang En once again carefully looked at the entrances of the two tunnels, the rock wall trends, and the traces on the ground. After a moment, he shook his head slightly and said in a calm tone: "You can't see any difference with the naked eye. The road conditions and trends of the two roads are almost exactly the same, so there is no way to judge the advantages and disadvantages."
Baker lowered his head to ponder for a moment, quickly weighed the pros and cons, and quickly came up with a solid investigation plan. He raised his head and proposed to everyone: "Since we can't tell the difference, let's investigate separately. Everyone walks fifty steps forward in each tunnel. If no clues are found, the way forward is blocked, or there is an abnormal situation, immediately turn back and meet here to discuss the countermeasures again."
"This is a safe method, so let's do it." Jiang En nodded slightly and agreed to the proposal calmly.
After finalizing the plan, Baker immediately turned to look at the worker Jacques beside him, and quickly made group arrangements: "Jacques, you and I will go together. Let's take this spacious and open main channel to explore the road conditions here."
Without any hesitation, Jacques immediately nodded in agreement and said simply: "Okay, let's set off immediately." After saying that, the two of them stepped side by side, walking steadily deep into the spacious main tunnel in front of them in the dim light, and their figures gradually merged into the deep darkness.
Watching Baker and Jacques disappear completely at the end of the passage, Jiang En turned to look at the tall worker standing silently beside him. Just as he was about to speak, the other party accurately understood what he meant and answered softly: "The only remaining access is this narrow path, let's go this way."
Jiang En nodded slightly, and the two looked at each other. No need to say anything, they had already reached a tacit understanding. Then they raised their feet together, carefully stepped into the narrow and dark tunnel on the other side, and continued to explore forward.
At the same time, in the empty and silent hall, a huge stone statue stood quietly in the center of the venue. The cold stone surface reflected the faint light, revealing a solemn silence. Polly's little body huddled tightly in the dark corner behind the stone statue, her whole body buried deep in the shadows, and she did not dare to make any sound. At first, she could forcefully suppress the panic and anxiety in her heart, hold her breath, and nervously pay attention to all the movements inside and outside the hall, always alert to sudden dangers. But time passed slowly minute by minute, and the long and painful wait continued to wear away her patience and concentration.
There was always silence around her, and the unknown fear quietly spread and accumulated in her heart, making it impossible for her to curl up and hide safely. The anxiety and uneasiness in her heart completely overflowed. She slowly straightened her crouched body, stood up slowly, and paced back and forth in the empty and cold hall, wandering uneasily. Her eyes frantically scanned the surrounding stone statues, walls, and dark entrances and exits. Her brows and eyes were full of anxiety, panic, and confusion. Her whole body was wrapped in invisible tension, and every inch of her breath was filled with extreme uneasiness.
("Writer! Da..." The priest immediately wanted to shout after seeing the writer, but the writer immediately stopped him and said: "We are all on the same side, Shamo."
The writer hiding in yesterday's place continued: "You don't trust Zhang Fo out of instinct, I don't trust him because I know the truth."
The priest looked at the writer suspiciously and asked, "Why should I believe you?"
"That's a good question, and I hope I can come up with a good answer," the writer said.
The priest relaxed and then said, "Okay, tell me what do you know?"
The writer realizes that guards have come to himBehind him, he said directly: "Let's talk here?"
"I know a place where I won't be disturbed," said the priest, and the writer followed him away.
In a certain passage in the mining area, four people gathered together.
"Which way to go now?" Jiang En asked, looking around.
"This side, or that side?" Baker asked, pointing to the passage leading to the two places in front.
"Oh, both are pretty much the same." Jiang En said.
"Let's try walking fifty steps through each tunnel before turning back." Baker suggested, looking toward the passage.
"Yes." Jiang En also nodded in agreement.
"Jacques, I think I'll go with you. Let's take this road." Baker said to the worker named Jacques.
"Well, let's go then." Jacques nodded in agreement, and the two of them walked towards a passage.
